customers_say: Customers find the water purifier easy to use and appreciate its quick installation process, with good water quality and taste that can be adjusted. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some report no issues, others mention the purifier stopping working and filters breaking within 6 months. Moreover, several customers report continuous leakage from the machine. The value for money also receives mixed reviews, with some considering it the best option within its price range while others find it not worth the investment.
